free_tier.stated: No standing free tier: the first-party documentation lists an individual plan with 1 GB of storage, and the signup page offers only a 14-day free trial, after which a paid subscription applies.
free_tier.notes: the offer existed; the rejection records why it is unusable here

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object size cap stated; storage is a project quota (individual 1 GB, dedicated 100 GB), not a per-object limit.
per_object_cap.notes: not applicable: a rejected offer has no per-object cap to shard

retention.stated: No fixed retention period; artifacts are kept until removed by tag-retention rules or garbage collection, which the administrator schedules.
retention.notes: Binding failure documented in record details.

egress.terms: stated-absent: the first-party pages state no price or quota for traffic out of the registry

interface_detail: An OCI container registry: push and pull images with Docker by tag or digest; a repository holds images, Helm charts and OCI indexes.
chaining: Chains with OCI tooling (Docker, Helm) and replicates to or from other registries; a proxy-cache project pulls through Docker Hub and other registries.
limits_note: the finding is the failure, not a constraint with a number
reliability_note: Per-user dedicated Harbor instances with project-level storage quotas; the pricing markdown twin renders empty (JS-gated) and signup provisions a paid subscription instance rather than a fre
confidence_note: Rejection quoted from historical research records; unverified against live endpoints.
